claims: BTS released their fifth studio album Arirang on March 20, 2026, at 1 PM KST.
Physical copies of Arirang are available for order on Weverse.
Physical copies of Arirang are available for order on Barnes & Noble.
The music video for "Swim" was released alongside Arirang.
A live concert to celebrate the Arirang release is scheduled for March 21, 2026, at Gwanghwamun Square in Seoul.
The live concert will be streamed on Netflix.
The Return is set for release on Netflix on March 27.
Arirang features collaborations with Kevin Parker.
Arirang features collaborations with Ryan Tedder.
Arirang marks BTS's full-group return after a three-year hiatus
